text_block_list.text:
At dusk. Walking alongside Kitasan Black
after finishing up helping out the neighborhood association—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Huh, there's a crowd up ahead... What could it be?
Is it a festival?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle is underway~!
The grand prize is an all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
2nd prize is "Mountain of Carrots"!
3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the fun, fun lottery!
Anyone and everyone, come on over!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Wah, it's a raffle draw!
I just love testing my luck!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ah... but we don't have raffle tickets, do we?
We haven't done any shopping today, either.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Oh, if it isn't Kita-chan.
Thanks as always for helping out with the neighborhood association.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: I'll give you one free spin as a special treat, so go ahead and draw.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Really, mister!?
Woohoo, we did it, Trainer!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, when you do good deeds,
good things come right back to you, right?
All right, let's draw!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Trainer-san, let's liven things up
and turn the crank! Seiya, soiya!

Shoulders bouncing with excitement alongside
Kitasan Black, I give the raffle drum a hearty spin!
And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!!
The Grand Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been won~~~~!!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yaaaaay!! Trainer, look!
It's the grand prize! The grand prize!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"A hot spring trip...! It's gonna be an absolute festival
of eating like crazy and relaxing to the max!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ah... but~ I'd feel kinda bad, you know...?
Getting to draw as a freebie and then snagging
the grand prize just like that.
choice_data_list: Well... that's just how it is.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
What are you talking about, you two?
Do you know how much this neighborhood association owes to Kita-chan?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
If you pulled the winning ticket fair and square,
everyone will be thrilled. Go right ahead and enjoy it.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Mister...
If you're going that far to say so...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, why don't we graciously accept
their kind offer with open arms?
We should match their enthusiasm, after all!
—And so, I gratefully accepted the hot springs trip ticket.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, we can't just go right away,
can we? I mean, this year..."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
This is an important year for both Dia-chan and me.
We can't afford to get carried away.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Once I safely fulfill my promise with Dia-chan
and feel like it's okay to reward myself,
then I'll use this ticket..."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
If that happens, can I assume we'll use it,
Trainer?
choice_data_list: Alright, let's do that. Let's do our best!
Yeah, let's do that. Let's do our best!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yes! I'm going to achieve splendid results this year! And then—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"I'm gonna soak in the hot springs to my heart's content!
I'll even hum Dad's hit songs in the tub!"

"Beyond victory, she sees the rising steam of a hot spring. Setting her sights
on the hot spring trip, Kitasan Black was bursting
with fighting spirit and smiles!"

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~!
The prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Wooww, I won some really
hearty side dishes!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
It's huge!
You could totally use this as a cooking pot, right, Trainer-san?
choice_data_list: A pot? Are you using it to boil something?
A pot? Are you using it to boil something?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
No, it's not that—I mean we could
all gather around it together instead of having hot pot.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Food is best enjoyed when everyone gathers around and digs in together!
That's how we always do it back home with my apprentices!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, since we have all this,
why don't we invite some other people to eat with us?
Like Dia-chan!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, Kita-chan, what's all this!?
Did carrots fall from the sky
and stick into the ground?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, that's going a bit far, Dia-chan...
Come on, let's eat, let's eat!

Gathered around the giant hamburger steak,
the three of them had a lively and cheerful time!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!!
The prize is a "Mountain of Carrots"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: T-That's so much...! Are you really sure I can have all of this!?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: So many carrots... Looking at this reminds me of when we helped out at the soup kitchen.
choice_data_list: Were you running a soup kitchen?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I help out
around the house a lot!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hot soup simmered in a giant pot out in the snow...
It brings so much joy to people shivering from the cold...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: "I can never forget that look of pure relief on their faces. It made me think, 'I'm so glad I came.'"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Oops, no time to dilly-dally. Everyone is waiting for these carrots!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Come on Trainer-san, let's hurry!
We have to get to the venue!
choice_data_list: I told you, this one isn't for volunteering!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Aah?! That's right, my bad~

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Let's take it home and gratefully enjoy it then. Since we have so much, we can share it with everyone around us!
And so, we decided to make the carrots into soup and share it around. Everyone loved its nourishing flavor.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
3rd prize~!
The prize is "one carrot"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, only one?
That's a bit frustrating...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, Trainer.
Turned out to be kind of an underwhelming result~.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. Perhaps I was just
lacking a bit of fighting spirit.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's it! In that case, how about this?
Use that carrot as a microphone for a recital!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I'm going to sing enka songs, which aren't usually performed at Winning Lives, as a special treat!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
One little carrot~♪
Hidden deep inside my sarashi-i-i-i!

A mysterious carrot enka echoed through the evening sky.
Afterwards, the carrots were enjoyed as part of the evening dinner.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost!
Your consolation prize is a pack of tissues~
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Auugh, tissues, please~
Trainer, I messed up...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"I tend to rely purely on momentum,
so there are plenty of times I don't get results..."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"What should I have done?
Turned it more gently, perhaps...?"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
No, or maybe! How about turning it so fast
that the handle practically snaps off?!
choice_data_list: Wouldn't tissues be better than breaking it?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh, that makes sense...
Still, pocket tissues, huh...

With all her efforts coming to nothing,
Kitasan Black slumped her shoulders in disappointment...
